source.note: Composed from the event's `{type, data}` schema in Hexclave's webhooks OpenAPI (docs.hexclave.com/openapi/webhooks.json), each value the `example` printed on that property; every property prints one, so nothing is left out or inferred. Hexclave publishes no whole example body for this event. The schema describes `data.id` as "The unique identifier of the user" and prints the user schema's example ID; both are kept as printed.
